notes: Derived from assets/references/2026-09-28/neo-tokyo-color-board.webp via Tools/sample_reference_colors.py, then re-ranked on 2026-09-28 (owner decision): gold is the primary accent, blue and pink are fallbacks, green is tertiary for informational numbers, coral is Knowledge. Contrast is checked by Tools/check_token_contrast.py; do not edit colors without re-running it.

hierarchy.notes: One accent per region. Gold carries XP, level progress, the character glow, selection and confirmation. Blue then pink are used only when a region already uses gold and needs a second accent (links, imported-data badges). Green marks informational numbers such as weekly minutes; never actions. Coral is shared by Knowledge and destructive actions; the two never appear on the same screen in MVP.

base.role: App background. Deep navy-black, never pure black.

scene_fade.role: Color that scene backdrops dither/fade into at their edges.

primary.role: Body and headings on any surface.

on_accent.role: Text on a filled accent or on the primary button.

gold.role: PRIMARY. XP, level progress, character glow, selection, confirmation, PRs and rare unlocks.

green.role: Tertiary. Informational numbers only (weekly minutes, session counts). Mindfulness.

button.role: Primary button fill: off-white with a hint of blue. Text on it is text.on_accent.

type.notes: Fitness app first: clean, athletic numerals at every size. Barlow (SIL OFL) for UI text; Barlow Semi Condensed for large stats. Every numeric label enables tabular figures. Files live in App/Resources/Fonts with OFL.txt.
